fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on gallons expected to be consumed in 2018, for every one cent increase in the cost of a gallon of jet fuel, our fuel expense would increase by approximately $1.8 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: Heating oil swaps and crude oil call options. Not designated as ASC 815 hedges. FV net asset $20.6M at Dec 31 2017. 94,332 thousand gallons (= 94.332M gallons) settling December 2018, covering ~35% of projected 2018 fuel requirements per item7a.

warnings: 94,332 gallons (thousands) from position table; 35% pct from item7a text; crude oil call options may overstate jet fuel equivalent gallons
